canonical_long_table: features/json_long.csv.gz: doi_group, file, mat_idx, role, canon_name, key, key_class (identity/outcome/characterisation/property/process/other), value_kind, value_raw, value_num

paper_states.empty: JSON parsed but 0 material records (17 dev+final papers) -> all M3 features NaN (production v4 set them to 0)
paper_states.uncovered: no JSON for the publication -> NaN
paper_states.unjoined: JSON whose DOI matches no PDP publication

doi_resolution_rules: R3 JSON 'source' field when it is a DOI

flag_variants.strict: fixed + extended outcome-key filter (stability / PCE [%] / Voc (V) ... keys removed before the regex search)
